label: Is every holder of the joint-absence power the selected root that the intellect routes reach?
summary: See docs/notes/holder-root-identification.md. Verified zero-axiom results: 88f1ee6e (every holder is an actual root of the selected grounding G on the frame's existence, from excluded middle, P2' 906f5c39, P3' a6906cab, holders existing at w and NAR, NECESSARY_2 actual concreta are roots), 1be2993c (813a9181 from that and the common GOD_4 root with intellect 0c27f65a), cb42e5e2 (every holder is GOD_4, the converse of 0050b6ed), 9b7683e1 (at most one holder from at most one actual root 49fdec01, whose uniqueness premise is a576300f, De ente's no-multiplication inventory), 834ddcfa (66aecdd7 from #1941's willed holder fdd2b1cf, 0050b6ed, at most one holder and 65e0179f). Law 1 derives the necessity of every holder from P2' and P3'. Main finding: uniqueness does not identify the holder; in the necessary-through-another model both uniqueness premises hold and the holder is a necessary being grounded by the root. The identification's crux is NAR. Frames joined only by FirstMoverNecessity.groundProfile; G is a parameter, not giving, causing, dependence or priority. Argument 5 shares the will-specific premise 090be689 with 571e36f0 and 13338e9c, so it adds no independent support for the will-follows-intellect step; its intellect input is the governor endpoint 0c27f65a, not 29818edd, and through 0050b6ed and at most one holder it carries that one witness's intellect to every GOD_4: an alternative intellect bundle, not a re-presentation of 571e36f0. Computed delta (base 87857479e): support alternatives added for 0a995309, 5c1aba17, 5f93d4f0, 66aecdd7, 813a9181 and fdd2b1cf; bare premises now reaching the root: 43651417 (NAR), b517ca3e (holders at w), 71fc097b and 9856239a (through argument B).
blocker: Not blocked for the formal question. Open warrant: NAR (that a modally necessary actual concretum has no actual concrete ground). Its warrant is direct prima facie plausibility; no independent support was found (aseity restates it, free creation is theist-internal). Strongest rival: a NECESSARY_2 actual concretum with an actual concrete G-ground that holds the power (the shape of Avicenna's necessary through another, whose causal version bears on NAR only through cb1cdea9). Next test: derive NAR from (a) the root's giving to every G-grounded concretum is two-way and (b) a G-grounded concretum exists at v only if it is given being at v (an explicit G-to-giving bridge).
